purpose: Compilador host determinista: script.plan + dataset + transcripción de MP3 real a escena Atlas, sin modificar motor ni llamar modelos.
profile: Mismo perfil efectivo y slug/category de atlas_factory.py; sandbox v2/v3 exclusivamente. Lock compartido por episodio.

country: flag_src and portrait_src: local relative to assets/
leader.term_display optional one or two compact lines; display_role optional
flag_fit:global(default)|landmass for disconnected territories; preserves all boundaries
cinematic_frame:{center,span} optional countrywide oblique frame; never region zoom
region: photo:{src,caption,focus} real local regional photo with SHA-matched media credit

alignment: Global monotonic difflib on normalized Spanish words, numeric expansion including leading decimal zeros, and explicit PIB/FMI/EE.UU. aliases. All real words remain in comparison; words below30ms cannot independently anchor visuals and are listed separately without calling them omissions. Only equal blocks of >=3 atoms produce anchors. Coverage >=0.68 and unmatched boundary <=8 atoms per segment; failures stop before scene write. No interpolated times, invented anchors or inserted words. Uncertainty remains visible in alignment.json.
timing: Real aligned word boundaries anchor country, insight, region and outro. A real word end4–5s after flag reveal ends vivid hold, then a later real word starts portrait. Flag persists through chapter and reaches4% at first region. Country handoff starts at the NEXT country aligned segment, overview0.9s, arrow+.95s, arrival at a real word at least3.4s after chapterstart. Never remove a region/photo or move camera before its spoken text ends. Effect durations are visual design, not speech estimates.
scene: Ranking8→1. Exact16regional geometries in red. Original tilted satellite Mercator look atpitch60; countrywide pose held through both regions. Persistent local flag94%→12%→4%, HUDphoto130% andname/cargo/mandate120%, GDPnominal/source/year. 16documentary regional photos use panel,circular,hexagonal with geographic connectors and screen-safe placement.7country transitionarrows show editorial itinerary, no economic flow claims. Captions fromfinal real MP3. No globe restyling. Closing uses atlas.outrov2 from the shared catalog: rotating Earth below the title through the actual audio end.
verification: Runs only fixed local Node Atlas check --ready. No browser, downloads, render, TTS, publication, agent or model. Successful ready check establishes schema/media/research references, not factual truth, word omissions, image rights or visual quality. Report leaves listening, portrait/landscape QA and tile verification to supervisor.
resume: Existing scene reused only when input hashes, compiler version, scene hash and prior ready success agree. Otherwise requires explicit --force. Changed inputs during compilation fail before scene write. Shared orchestration hash and all regional media/credits are bound too. Compiler SHA, component-plan SHA and current geo.resolved SHA must match. Geometry is regenerated from current scene preserving original layerindices before ready validation.
usage: Local kit/storyboard/atlas-compile usage entry; no token meter, usage_known=false. Never present unknown as zero cost.
country_presentation: Shared _atlas/orchestration.json is mandatory. Country frames use cinematic_frame or center/span; originalpitch60,bearing4,satelite-realista. No regioncamera key; transitionoverview exposes bothends before arrival. Inspect country coverage, arrows, regionalconnections,media and all text in native16:9 and9:16.

closing.timing: Start at aligned outro segment, finish at actual MP3 duration. Transition to space/globe only during the closing; keep country chapters oblique.
closing.checks: Capture entry, midpoint and duration−0.05s in both native formats. A final title over the satellite map is not the Atlas outro.
closing.generic_proto_cta: scene.outro=false deliberately suppresses the generic subscription overlay; atlas.outrov2 is a composed camera/look/layers recipe.
